current_prompt.body:
DETERMINE whether the list L of 45 distinct positive integers can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for every triple i.
IF a valid partition exists, PROVIDE one complete example of such a partition.

current_plan.body:
ANALYZE the set L of 45 distinct positive integers
IF a valid partition into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) with a_i + b_i = c_i exists THEN
    CONSTRUCT one such partition by selecting appropriate triples that satisfy the sum condition and cover all elements of L without overlap
ELSE
    REPORT that no such partition exists
